40.
(1) A licensed clearing house which is aggrieved by
the decision of the Commission made under subsection (1)
of section 39, may, within fourteen days after the clearing
house is notified of the decision, appeal to the Minister.
(2)  Notwithstanding  the  lodging  of  an  appeal  under
subsection (1), any action taken by the Commission under
this section shall continue to have effect pending the decision
of the Minister.
